snippet.title: Nintendo Switch Sports Resort – Nintendo Direct 6.9.2026
snippet.description:
Nintendo Switch Sports Resort launches exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2 on Oct 22, 2026. Pre-order today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/nintendo-switch-sports-resort-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01

Welcome to Wuhu Island, home to all kinds of sports. There are 12 sports to choose from, all with intuitive motion controls. Use the Joy-Con 2 controllers as rackets, bows or even handles!

#NintendoSwitchSportsResort #NintendoDirect #NintendoSwitch2

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
